title: Agent teams cost far more without reliably improving results
friendlyTitle: More AI agents often cost more without doing better work
summary: Vals AI compared solo coding agents with teams using GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5. Teams cost between 1.8 and 5.1 times as much, while only one of four comparisons produced a statistically significant quality gain.
friendlySummary: In this test, teams of coding agents used much more money and tokens, but usually did not produce clearly better results than one agent.
whyItMatters: More agents are not automatically better. Before adopting a swarm, teams should benchmark a single strong agent, measure quality and latency, and include coordination overhead in the cost calculation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Try one capable agent first. Add more agents only when your own tests show that the extra cost brings a real benefit.
